theme: A strategy that cannot be exploited
title: Unexploitable Play Against a Logged Opponent
strategies: trivial: pure best row assuming the opponent plays uniformly at random over columns (ignores the log entirely)
greedy: soft best-response to the opponent's historical column-play log (weights rows by expected payoff against the log)
strong: solve the maximin LP directly (sum_i p_i A_ij >= t for all j, maximize t) to identify the true equilibrium support, ignoring the log
invalid: emit m numbers that do not form a probability distribution
